Community Service

Serving others is following the example of Jesus Christ. Join us.

Serving our community

Jesus Christ devoted His life to serving others. We try to follow His example. We regularly organize community service projects throughout Spain, and you are invited to take part.

You don't need to be a member of the Church — anyone who wants to help is welcome. Together we can make a real difference in our community.

Types of service

  • Cleaning parks and public spaces
  • Visits to nursing homes
  • Collecting and distributing food
  • Support for local food banks
  • Neighborhood beautification projects
  • Helping older people with household tasks

Why do we serve?

We believe that when we serve others, we serve God. Service brings us closer to Jesus Christ, connects us with our community and reminds us that we are all brothers and sisters.

Besides, serving simply feels good. There is something powerful in forgetting yourself for a moment and giving your time to someone who needs it.

Join as a volunteer

It doesn't matter how much time you have — an hour, a morning or a whole day. Every contribution counts. Contact us to find out when the next service project is and how you can take part.

I want to serve

Write to us and we will let you know about upcoming service opportunities in your area.
